name: MuslimInk
author: fiqsr
changelog_id: Perbaikan OTA Update: Sistem penyimpanan bertahap (chunked append) langsung ke folder aplikasi XTApps/muslimink/files/muslimink_update.xtapp
Bypass Buffer Limit: Mengatasi limit penulisan tunggal 256 KB firmware dengan multi-strategy fallback
Pembersihan UI Modal Unduhan: Menghapus garis arsir latar belakang yang bocor dan menyembunyikan scrollbar pengaturan di balik modal
Pemasangan Otomatis: Integrasi tombol Pasang Sekarang yang memicu installer sistem via ctx.system:open
changelog_en: OTA Update Fix: Chunked append storage engine direct to app directory XTApps/muslimink/files/muslimink_update.xtapp
Buffer Limit Bypass: Solved 256 KB firmware single-write ceiling using resilient multi-tier fallback
Download Modal UI Polish: Removed background scrim pattern bleed and hidden background scrollbar during updates
Auto-Install Trigger: Integrated Install Now action invoking OS firmware installer via ctx.system:open
